WITH s AS (
 SELECT st.store_id, count(*) n_lines, count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) n_days, sum(f.net_amount) sales_net, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) staff_net, min(f.sale_date) d0, max(f.sale_date) d1
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (
 SELECT st.store_id, count(*) n_ret, sum(r.refund_net) refunds_net
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key
 WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1),
d AS (
 SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) rpt_gross, sum(returns_net) rpt_ret, sum(net_sales) rpt_net, count(*) rpt_days
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(s.store_id,r.store_id,d.store_id) store_id, n_lines, n_days, sales_net, staff_net, d0, d1, n_ret, refunds_net, sales_net-coalesce(refunds_net,0) calc_net, rpt_gross, rpt_ret, rpt_net, rpt_days
FROM s FULL JOIN r USING (store_id) FULL JOIN d ON d.store_id=coalesce(s.store_id,r.store_id) ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH p AS (SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=2),
sales AS (
 SELECT st.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key CROSS JOIN p
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN p.period_start_date AND p.period_end_date AND st.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1),
refunds AS (
 SELECT st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds_net
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key CROSS JOIN p
 WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN p.period_start_date AND p.period_end_date AND st.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1),
names AS (SELECT store_id, store_name FROM dim_store WHERE is_current)
SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY s.sales_net - coalesce(r.refunds_net,0) DESC) AS league_rank,
 p.fiscal_year, p.fiscal_period, s.store_id, n.store_name,
 CAST(s.sales_net - coalesce(r.refunds_net,0) AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS net_sales
FROM sales s LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (store_id) JOIN names n USING (store_id) CROSS JOIN p
ORDER BY league_rank
